method: Actual Ruffle AVM1 film function queries at live original pointer settings versus independent complex characteristic-matrix HTML equations

results.scope: 21 wavelength queries in actual Ruffle at default and five actual settings per original class-based slider, with original limits checked. Raw drags retained; original +/- triangle clicks reach fine settings between screen pixels. Three original graph clicks (one nm inside each border and midpoint) compare wavelength and four-decimal reflectance/transmittance readout. Query calls may update temporary original matrix variables. Exact border hit tests, all combinations, full curve pixels, copied clipboard data and source color swatches are outside scope. These class-based components are separate from the earlier 125 AS2 candidates.
